QUOTE: Archive action | `actions/remote/channel.ts:1397-1401` | Sets `delete_at` locally and keeps the user in the channel | Removes the current user from the channel locally; Websocket channel-archived event | ... | Nothing extra; the channel stays visible | Kicks the user out if it is the current channel, then removes membership
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when archived channels aren't viewable, the user is removed from the channel (and kicked out if it is the current channel), and that when viewable the channel stays. It describes "sets delete_at" for the archive action, which matches "marked deleted".
